subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window to a compact one-line summary, and this request asks for a new public config/lifecycle policy rather than a broken documented behavior fix.

options.title: Accept default-off full draft preservation
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option and checklist presentation while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

options.title: Keep the current one-line summary
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep the current final-answer plus compact activity digest behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track this as a broader cross-channel structured progress-card design instead of adding a Telegram-only finalization flag.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off full draft preservation
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option and checklist presentation while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest targeted Telegram progress lifecycle history among the locally verifiable commits.
